name: COUGAR EGY K22 Wireless Hall Effect Multi-Platform Gaming Controller Black
shortDescription: COUGAR EGY K22 Wireless Hall Effect Multi-Platform Gaming Controller - Black (Triple-Mode Connection / Hall Effect Analog Sticks & Triggers / PC, PS4, PS3, Switch, Android, iOS Support / X-Input Xbox 360 Recognition
descriptionHtml:
COUGAR EGY K22 Wireless Hall Effect Multi-Platform Gaming Controller - Black (Triple-Mode Connection / Hall Effect Analog Sticks & Triggers / PC, PS4, PS3, Switch, Android, iOS Support / X-Input Xbox 360 Recognition Mode / 1-Year Official Warranty)

Experience precision and ultimate versatility with the COUGAR EGY K22 Wireless Multi-Platform Gaming Controller in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Built with zero-drift Hall Effect magnetic analog sticks and triggers, this controller features triple-mode connectivity (Bluetooth, 2.4GHz Wireless, and USB Type-C Wired), programmable macro back buttons, customizable Turbo speed, dual-zone RGB lighting, and automatic recognition as an X-Input Xbox 360 controller on PC for seamless game compatibility across Windows PC, PS4, PS3, Nintendo Switch, Android, and iOS platforms.
